description: This file defines a mock class 'MockINetworkManager' for unit testing purposes. It mimics the interface of 'WPEFramework::Exchange::INetworkManager' by providing mocked method implementations using Google Mock for network management operations in a software project.

classes.description: A mock class for the 'INetworkManager' interface used in unit tests to simulate network management behaviors.
